title: Planner Handoff (rdd-planner stage exit)
description: Schema for .rddf/state/.planner-handoff.json emitted by rdd-planner stage exit. Consumed by rdd-builder Phase 0 (approval gate reads proposals_authored) and rdd-arch advisory (via .planner-feedback.json). Per spec §3.3, §6.1. Backward compat: coexists with .planner-state.json (Stage 2, current sprint view) and .planner-feedback.json (ADR-0042, persistent review tasks); each has its own FileLock.
